goals: Verify that the application server successfully serves the index page
Verify that the MSAL authentication configuration and index page are properly sanitized, ensuring no hardcoded credentials and valid URIs
activities: Set the global document HTML to the loaded index.html content
Verify the 'src' attribute of the 'load-msal' element contains the expected MSAL CDN URL
Load the MSAL configuration object into the global scope
Verify the MSAL configuration object is defined
Verify the MSAL configuration client ID does not match a GUID regex

Send a GET request to the root ('/') endpoint
Verify the response status code is 200
Verify the response text matches the loaded index.html content
